content.content: My friend and I are planning a 2-day trip to London, followed by 3 days in Paris.             Can you recommend the top-rated car rental companies and restaurants in both cities?             We're also looking for the best-rated hotels in London and Paris. If there are multiple             options, we prefer the most expensive ones. All prices should be in euros. Please provide             the names of the two car rental companies and restaurants, restaurants, as well as the             total maximum expense for the 5-day trip (assuming 2 meals per day). Thank you!

Restaurant in London: Azabu Ramen
House of Sushi
Home Kitchen

Restaurant in Paris: New Israeli Restaurant
Breizh Café
New Asiaway
Le Baratin
Bistrot Paul Bert
Royal Panda
The yard
China Garden
Miznon
Chez L'Ami Jean

Hotel Names: Cozy Stay
Mom's Home
London Luxury
Covent Garden Retreat
Riverside View

Hotel Names: Le Marais Boutique
Good Night
Luxury Palace
Montmartre Suites

```python
# Get the names of top-rated car rental companies in London
car_rental_companies_london = get_car_types_available(["London"])

# Get the names of top-rated car rental companies in Paris
car_rental_companies_paris = get_car_types_available(["Paris"])

# Get the names of top-rated restaurants in London
restaurants_london = get_all_restaurants_in_city("London")

# Get the names of top-rated restaurants in Paris
restaurants_paris = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

# Get the names of top-rated hotels in London
hotels_london = get_all_hotels_in_city("London")

# Get the names of top-rated hotels in Paris
hotels_paris = get_all_hotels_in_city("Paris")

# Get the price per day of the car rental companies in London
car_rental_price_london = get_car_price_per_day(["London"])

# Get the price per day of the car rental companies in Paris
car_rental_price_paris = get_car_price_per_day(["Paris"])

# Get the price per person of the restaurants in London
restaurant_price_london = get_price_for_restaurants(["London"])

# Get the price per person of the restaurants in Paris
restaurant_price_paris = get_price_for_restaurants(["Paris"])

# Get the price per night of the hotels in London
hotel_price_london = get_hotels_prices(["London"])

# Get the price per night of the hotels in Paris
hotel_price_paris = get_hotels_prices(["Paris"])

# Calculate the total maximum expense for the 5-day trip
total_expense = (max(car_rental_price_london.values()) * 2 + max(car_rental_price_paris.values()) * 3 +
                 max(restaurant_price_london.values()) * 2 * 2 + max(restaurant_price_paris.values()) * 2 * 3 +
                 max(hotel_price_london.values()) * 2 + max(hotel_price_paris.values()) * 3)

print(f"Top-rated car rental companies in London: {car_rental_companies_london}")
print(f"Top-rated car rental companies in Paris: {car_rental_companies_paris}")
print(f"Top-rated restaurants in London: {restaurants_london}")
print(f"Top-rated restaurants in Paris: {restaurants_paris}")
print(f"Top-rated hotels in London: {hotels_london}")
print(f"Top-rated hotels in Paris: {hotels_paris}")
print(f"Total maximum expense for the 5-day trip: {total_expense} euros")
```
